name: Yūbari (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Yūbari city emblem in white: an outlined hexagon of concentric lines enclosing a stylised character in a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Yūbari, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 2 August 1937.

features.role: Yūbari city emblem — an outlined hexagon of concentric lines enclosing a stylised character in a disc
